topic: General precautions to be observed while working on propeller, ground run

specific_objectives: 7.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to explain propellers and its associated maintenance practice

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of propeller ground run safety checks, instructor supervision of trainee observation, safety precautions regarding blade clearance and personnel positioning
intro_questions: What are the primary components of a propeller assembly?
Why is a ground run performed before engine start?
What is the standard safety distance for personnel during a propeller ground run?

summary_questions: List three critical safety precautions during a propeller ground run.
Explain the procedure for identifying a damaged propeller blade during inspection.
Describe the correct steps to take if abnormal vibration occurs during a ground run.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report outlining the key differences between pre-flight propeller inspection and post-ground run inspection, referencing the next lesson plan (LP 02) on detailed propeller maintenance.
